messages:
marta: Quick review of the 'starry-slate' dark mock. Main things: syntax tokens blend, donut charts lose inner ring contrast at small sizes, and theme toggle copy reads 'Dim Mode' which confuses folks. Screenshot: https://mock.img/starry :sparkles:
yusuf: The spectral accent (teal->indigo) is pretty but the midtones get muddy at 16px. For tiny axis labels the teal reads too dark. Suggest lighten accent by ~12% and add 1px stroke to chart lines.
ella: Code blocks: current bg is almost same as card. Propose code-bg #0b1724, code-text #eaf7ff, padding 12px. Also increase token spacing so inline `var()` examples don't wrap.
marta: Copy nit: change 'Dim Mode' -> 'Dark theme' and surface a separate 'Reduce motion & contrast' toggle under Settings -> Accessibility. People confused by the label.
yusuf: Quick CSS vars suggestion:
--panel-900: #050814
--panel-800: #0b1724
--code-bg: #0b1724
--accent-primary: #5fe6ff
--accent-secondary: #9a7bff
Ran axis contrast checks @13px and these look fine.
design-bot: Filed issue GH#812 and opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/703 (starry-slate: chart/contrast tweaks + copy). CI: 1 visual diff (donut inner ring).
frank: For donuts try using a subtle inner-shadow or 2px inner stroke instead of increasing fill saturation. Keeps aesthetic while improving separation.
ella: Also request a new Accessibility setting: "High-contrast charts" (off by default) so we can test visuals without changing defaults.
marta: Action items: yusuf to tweak accents & add stroke; ella to update code spacing & copy; frank to prototype inner stroke; marta to run full contrast audit after PR. Target: staging tomorrow.
